description: 卡罗-坎恩古典变例 B17 — 兑换后反制：c5爆破制造孤兵弱点

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Lesson 3: Caro-Kann
Black uses ...c6 to build a solid structure and does not rush to counterattack. When is ...c5 most effective, and how can exchanges turn White's space advantage into an isolated-pawn target?
intro.popup:
反制中心第3课

卡罗-坎恩防御！
c6稳固结构

不急于反击
等待c5时机！

核心问题：
何时出击c5？
孤兵如何利用？

outro.popup_en: After exchanges, ...c5 can leave White with an isolated pawn. Black's bishop is active outside the pawn chain, and a knight on e5 can control the center. Evaluate whether White's initial space advantage has faded, whether the isolated pawn is a lasting weakness, and how well Black's pieces coordinate.
outro.popup:

moves.popup_en: ...c6 begins the Caro-Kann Defense and builds a solid structure.
moves.popup:
c6 卡罗-坎恩！
稳固结构

moves.popup_en: Nxe4 recaptures and restores White's central presence.
Ng5 sends the knight forward to attack.
Bd3 places White's bishop on an active diagonal.
...h6 challenges the knight and asks it to move.
...c5! Black chooses the moment to counterattack and break open White's center.
moves.popup:
c5！反击！
爆破白方中心

moves.popup_en: Ne5! White's knight occupies an important central square.
...Nbd7 develops the knight and supports Black's position.
Nc4 continues the pressure on Black's position.
...O-O completes Black's development and secures the king.
